title: Ultrasound deep learning radiomics identifies non-endometrioid endometrial carcinoma
summary: In 663 patients from 11 centers, radiomics features (PyRadiomics) and ResNet-101 deep features from transvaginal ultrasound were combined in machine learning classifiers. On an independent external cohort of 180 patients from three centers the combined model reached AUC 0.837, accuracy 0.756, sensitivity 0.800 and specificity 0.733, outperforming the radiomics-only and deep-learning-only models. The study is retrospective and the AUC is moderate.
ai_technology: ResNet-101 deep features combined with PyRadiomics features in machine learning classifiers on transvaginal ultrasound
organization: Capital Medical University; Sichuan University; Nanchong Central Hospital
